// PGlite verification of the multi-tenant persistence (copied into the generated project by the generator test).
// RLS=on: the DDL's row level security is checked as a non-superuser application role; RLS=off: no policy exists and
// the tenant filter of the generated statements alone isolates the tenants.
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { PGlite } from "@electric-sql/pglite";
import { pg_trgm } from "@electric-sql/pglite/contrib/pg_trgm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";

import { Invitation } from "../src/tenant_hiring/generated/hiring/domain/aggregates.js";
import { SearchInvitationsQuery } from "../src/tenant_hiring/generated/hiring/application/queries.js";
import { SupportRevokeInvitationUseCase } from "../src/tenant_hiring/generated/hiring/application/use-cases.js";
import { SupportRevokeInvitation } from "../src/tenant_hiring/generated/hiring/domain/commands.js";
import {
  PostgresInvitationRepository,
  PostgresSearchInvitationsReader,
} from "../src/tenant_hiring/generated/hiring/persistence/postgres.js";
import {
  CapturingEventPublisher,
  InMemoryInvitationRepository,
  InMemorySearchInvitationsReader,
  plain,
  RecordingCrossTenantAudit,
} from "../src/tenant_hiring/generated/hiring/testing.js";
import { HmacCursorCodec, InvalidCursor, type Page } from "../src/tenant_hiring/generated/persistence.js";
import { Principal, TenantMismatch, tenantId } from "../src/tenant_hiring/generated/security.js";

const RLS = process.env["RLS"] !== "off";
const A = tenantId("00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1");
const B = tenantId("00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000b2");
const cursors = new HmacCursorCodec({ secrets: ["pglite-test-secret-0123456789-0123456789"] });
const staff = (tenant: string | null) => Principal.create({ id: "staff-1", tenantId: tenant, roles: ["staff"] });

let db: PGlite;
beforeAll(async () => {
  db = new PGlite({ extensions: { pg_trgm } });
  const ddl = readFileSync("sql/hiring.sql", "utf8");
  expect(ddl.includes("ROW LEVEL SECURITY")).toBe(RLS);
  await db.exec(ddl);
  await db.exec(ddl); // idempotent
  // The application connects as a role that owns nothing and has no BYPASSRLS.
  await db.exec(`
    CREATE ROLE app NOLOGIN;
    GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA hiring TO app;
    GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA hiring TO app;
  `);
  // Seed both tenants (each in its own transaction, as a unit of work would).
  for (const [tenant, prefix] of [[A, "a"], [B, "b"]] as const) {
    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const repository = new PostgresInvitationRepository(tx);
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        await repository.save(tenant, invitation(tenant, prefix, i));
      }
    });
  }
  await db.exec("SET ROLE app");
}, 120_000);
afterAll(async () => {
  await db.close();
});

function invitation(tenant: string, prefix: string, i: number): Invitation {
  return Invitation.from({
    tenantId: tenant,
    id: `00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000${prefix === "a" ? "a" : "b"}000${String(i)}`,
    email: { value: `${prefix}${String(i)}.staff@example.com` },
    status: i % 2 ? "accepted" : "pending",
    createdAt: `2026-01-0${String((i % 3) + 1)}T10:00:00+00:00`,
  });
}

async function all<T>(run: (cursor: string | null) => Promise<Page<T>>): Promise<T[]> {
  const out: T[] = [];
  let cursor: string | null = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    const page: Page<T> = await run(cursor);
    out.push(...page.items);
    cursor = page.nextCursor;
    if (cursor === null) return out;
  }
  throw new Error("too many pages");
}

describe(`tenant isolation on PostgreSQL (rls: ${RLS ? "on" : "off"})`, () => {
  test("repositories: another tenant's aggregate is not found, saving for another tenant is refused", async () => {
    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const repository = new PostgresInvitationRepository(tx);
      expect(await repository.get(A, invitation(A, "a", 0).id)).not.toBeNull();
      expect(await repository.get(A, invitation(B, "b", 0).id)).toBeNull();
      let refused: unknown;
      try {
        await repository.save(A, invitation(B, "b", 1));
      } catch (error) {
        refused = error;
      }
      expect(refused).toBeInstanceOf(TenantMismatch);
    });
  });

  test("queries: only the caller's tenant, equal to the in-memory reader; cursors are bound to the tenant", async () => {
    const memory = new InMemoryInvitationRepository();
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) memory.seed(invitation(A, "a", i), invitation(B, "b", i));
    const pg = new SearchInvitationsQuery({ reader: new PostgresSearchInvitationsReader(db), cursors });
    const mem = new SearchInvitationsQuery({ reader: new InMemorySearchInvitationsReader(memory), cursors });
    for (const input of [{}, { status: "pending" as const }, { q: "staff@example.com" }]) {
      const fromPg = await all((cursor) => pg.execute({ ...input, cursor, limit: 2 }, staff(A)));
      const fromMemory = await all((cursor) => mem.execute({ ...input, cursor, limit: 2 }, staff(A)));
      expect(plain(fromPg)).toEqual(plain(fromMemory));
      expect(fromPg.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(fromPg.every((item) => item.email.value.startsWith("a"))).toBe(true);
    }
    const first = await pg.execute({ limit: 1 }, staff(A));
    let rejected: unknown;
    try {
      await pg.execute({ limit: 1, cursor: first.nextCursor }, staff(B));
    } catch (error) {
      rejected = error;
    }
    expect(rejected).toBeInstanceOf(InvalidCursor);
  });

  test("a cross-tenant use case acts in the named tenant only (platform role, audited)", async () => {
    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const audit = new RecordingCrossTenantAudit();
      const useCase = new SupportRevokeInvitationUseCase({
        invitationRepository: new PostgresInvitationRepository(tx),
        eventPublisher: new CapturingEventPublisher(),
        unitOfWork: { commit: () => undefined, rollback: () => undefined },
        audit,
      });
      const support = Principal.create({ id: "support-1", tenantId: null, roles: [], platformRoles: ["support"] });
      await useCase.execute(SupportRevokeInvitation.create({ tenantId: B, invitationId: invitation(B, "b", 2).id }), support);
      expect(audit.accesses).toHaveLength(1);
      const stored = await new PostgresInvitationRepository(tx).get(B, invitation(B, "b", 2).id);
      expect(stored?.status).toBe("revoked");
    });
  });

  test.skipIf(!RLS)("row level security: a raw SELECT without WHERE sees the current tenant only; other tenants' writes fail", async () => {
    // Without a tenant set the policy matches nothing (fail closed).
    expect((await db.query<{ n: number }>("SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM hiring.invitation")).rows[0]?.n).toBe(0);
    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.query("SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', $1, true)", [A]);
      const rows = (await tx.query<{ tenant_id: string }>("SELECT * FROM hiring.invitation")).rows;
      expect(rows.length).toBe(5);
      expect(rows.every((row) => row.tenant_id === A)).toBe(true);
      // Updating another tenant's row changes nothing; moving a row to another tenant is refused.
      const updated = await tx.query("UPDATE hiring.invitation SET status = 'revoked' WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid RETURNING id", [B]);
      expect(updated.rows).toEqual([]);
    });
    let insertError: unknown;
    try {
      await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.query("SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', $1, true)", [A]);
        await tx.query(
          "INSERT INTO hiring.invitation (id, tenant_id, email_value, status, created_at, version) VALUES ('00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000c001', $1::uuid, 'x@example.com', 'pending', now(), 1)",
          [B],
        );
      });
    } catch (error) {
      insertError = error;
    }
    expect(String(insertError)).toContain("row-level security");
    // The setting ends with the transaction (SET LOCAL semantics).
    expect((await db.query<{ n: number }>("SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM hiring.invitation")).rows[0]?.n).toBe(0);
  });

  test.skipIf(!RLS)("row level security: a repository outside a transaction refuses to run", async () => {
    let error: unknown;
    try {
      await new PostgresInvitationRepository(db).get(A, invitation(A, "a", 0).id);
    } catch (e) {
      error = e;
    }
    expect(String(error)).toContain("transaction");
  });

  test.skipIf(RLS)("without row level security the generated statements still filter by tenant (autocommit works)", async () => {
    const repository = new PostgresInvitationRepository(db);
    expect(await repository.get(B, invitation(A, "a", 0).id)).toBeNull();
    expect(await repository.get(A, invitation(A, "a", 0).id)).not.toBeNull();
  });
});
